name: Alchemy FM Channel Designer
author: MMagTech
description: Design live radio channels in AudioMuse using CLAP, lyrics, mood clusters, and Song Alchemy — preview programming, then deploy to Alchemy FM.

versions.changelog: Catalog refresh publish — v2 Channel Designer (CLAP, lyrics, moods, preview, deploy).
Detect Cloudflare blocks with a clear error message; add User-Agent on Alchemy FM API calls. Settings note for public URLs behind Cloudflare.
Pivot to AudioMuse-native channel designer: CLAP sonic search, lyrics themes, mood centroids, preview with tempo/energy/mood, auto Song Alchemy anchor for 24/7 Alchemy FM deploy.
Fix 405 Method Not Allowed when pushing or testing — home route now accepts POST.
Fix plugin load error: ship single-file zip (AudioMuse could not import alchemy_client module).
Initial release: configure Alchemy FM URL and admin credentials, design stations from anchors or seed tracks, and idempotently create/update/bootstrap stations.
